D: A year in the life of students at Ridgemont High in California.
P: Serve the pizza when Spicoli has it delivered to history class.
S: Mini pizza rounds with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni
Rounds of pizza dough topped with tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 230C for 8 minutes, served in a pizza box.
Food court pretzels with cheddar sauce
Soft pretzels with warm cheddar sauce and yellow mustard

Soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, warmed until crisp outside, with a hot, smooth cheddar sauce and yellow mustard for dunking. Brush 4 soft pretzels with 30g melted butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Heat 375ml evaporated milk in a saucepan until steaming, then take off the heat and stir in 200g grated cheddar and half a tsp mustard powder until smooth. Pour into 4 paper cups and serve with the pretzels and a squeeze of yellow mustard.
Captain Hook flathead bites and chips
Brad's job at the fish and chips shop, in the pirate hat

Flathead strips in crisp beer batter with skin-on chips, chunky tartare sauce and lemon, served in paper cones like the shop on the strip. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, drain, then fry again at 190C for 3 minutes. Mix 200g plain flour with 1 tsp baking powder, salt and 300ml cold beer. Cut 500g flathead fillets into strips, dust in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped gherkins, capers, dill and lemon juice. Serve in paper cones with lemon wedges.
M: Spicoli orders pizza straight to Mr Hand's class

A big New York style pie with tangy tomato sauce, stretchy mozzarella, cupped pepperoni and mushrooms, finished with chilli flakes, oregano and parmesan. Put a pizza steel or stone in the oven at the highest setting for 45 minutes. Stretch 2 balls of pizza dough (250g each) into thin 30cm rounds. Spread each with 100g crushed tomato seasoned with salt, oregano and garlic. Top with 125g grated mozzarella, 60g sliced pepperoni and 80g sliced mushrooms. Bake each for 7 to 8 minutes until blistered. Finish with grated parmesan, oregano and chilli flakes and cut into big slices.
Cheddar cheeseburger on a sesame bun with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and fries
Thick chuck patty, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles on a toasted sesame bun, fries alongside.
W: Food court brown butter choc chip cookies
Big brown butter cookies with dark chocolate chips, chilled overnight

Big soft cookies made with brown butter dough rested overnight, chunky with dark choc chips, crisp at the edges and gooey in the middle. Cook 150g butter until it smells nutty and goes golden, then cool for 15 minutes. Beat with 200g brown sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Mix in 250g plain flour, half a tsp bicarb soda, a pinch of salt and 200g dark choc chips. Cover and chill overnight. Scoop 10 big balls onto lined trays and bake at 180C for 11 minutes, then cool on the tray for 10 minutes.
K: Strawberry, milk and vanilla blended thick with ice
Strawberries blended with milk, vanilla and ice into a frothy food court shake.
